name: Sable & Voss Welt-Sewn Ankle Boot
description:
A sharp, minimal ankle boot in genuine horsehide — among the rarest leathers commercially available in 2200 — with a Goodyear welt and a razor-thin sole of vulcanized natural rubber. The toe is almond-shaped, the heel a modest 4cm block. Available in jet black or raw umber. Sable & Voss offers resoling for life.

A statement of restraint. No augmentation ports, no sensors, no adaptive materials. Just an extraordinarily expensive, extraordinarily well-made boot that will look good for decades.
what_it_says: You understand quality at a molecular level. You don't need technology to be impressive.
worn_by: anyone who reads leather quality by touch
story_hooks: Sable & Voss's resoling records go back forty years — following a single pair of boots reveals a complete biography of a now-missing Tier 5 figure.
Horsehide this quality only comes from one licensed source. That source was just raided by a corponation enforcement team.
